title: In Vitro Fertilisation (IVF)
short: Eggs and sperm are combined in our lab and the healthiest embryo is transferred to the uterus.
description: IVF is the most effective treatment for many causes of infertility, including blocked tubes, endometriosis, low ovarian reserve and unexplained infertility. Your cycle is tailored with personalised stimulation, close ultrasound monitoring, egg retrieval under anaesthesia, fertilisation in our embryology lab and a gentle embryo transfer.
idealFor: Tubal factor, endometriosis, low AMH, unexplained infertility

title: ICSI
short: A single healthy sperm is injected directly into each mature egg to help fertilisation.
description: Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI) is performed as part of IVF when sperm count, movement or shape is low, or when fertilisation failed in a previous cycle. Our embryologists select the best sperm under high magnification and inject it into each mature egg.
idealFor: Low sperm count or motility, previous IVF fertilisation failure

title: Intrauterine Insemination (IUI)
short: Washed, concentrated sperm is placed directly into the uterus around the time of ovulation.
description: IUI is a simple, less invasive first-line treatment. It is often combined with mild ovulation induction and follicle tracking so insemination happens at the ideal time.
idealFor: Mild male factor, ovulation issues, unexplained infertility

title: Egg & Embryo Freezing
short: Preserve your fertility for the future with vitrification — fast-freezing of eggs or embryos.
description: Whether you are delaying pregnancy for personal or career reasons, or preparing for medical treatment such as chemotherapy, vitrification lets you store eggs or embryos for later use.
highlights: Counselling on the best age to freeze
idealFor: Planned parenthood later, before cancer treatment, surplus embryos

title: Fertility Assessment
short: A complete check-up for both partners to find the cause and the right path forward.
description: Your first step is understanding what is happening. We review your history and arrange hormone tests (including AMH), pelvic ultrasound, tubal assessment and semen analysis so that recommendations are based on clear information.
idealFor: Couples trying for 12 months, or 6 months if the woman is over 35

title: Male Infertility Care
short: Evaluation and treatment for male-factor infertility, including surgical sperm retrieval.
description: Male factors contribute to many cases of infertility. Our andrology team offers detailed semen analysis, hormone evaluation, lifestyle guidance and surgical sperm retrieval (PESA/TESA) when sperm is absent from the ejaculate.
idealFor: Low or absent sperm, poor motility, previous failed cycles

title: Preimplantation Genetic Testing (PGT)
short: Embryos are screened for chromosomal or specific genetic conditions before transfer.
description: PGT can help selected patients — such as those with known genetic conditions, recurrent miscarriage or repeated implantation failure — choose embryos with a normal chromosome count. Your doctor will discuss whether it is right for you.
idealFor: Recurrent miscarriage, known genetic disorders, repeated IVF failure

title: Hysteroscopy & Laparoscopy
short: Minimally invasive keyhole procedures to diagnose and treat problems in the uterus and pelvis.
description: Fibroids, polyps, septum, adhesions, endometriosis and blocked tubes can affect fertility. Our gynaecological endoscopy team treats them with minimally invasive techniques for faster recovery.
highlights: Treatment of fibroids, polyps and endometriosis

title: Donor Program
short: Ethical, confidential egg, sperm and embryo donation in line with Indian ART regulations.
description: When your own eggs or sperm cannot be used, donor programs offer another route to parenthood. All donations follow the ART (Regulation) Act, with screening, counselling and complete confidentiality.
idealFor: Very low ovarian reserve, premature menopause, absent sperm

title: Fertility Counselling
short: Emotional support, nutrition and lifestyle guidance through every stage of treatment.
description: Fertility treatment can be emotionally demanding. Our counsellors support you and your partner with stress management, nutrition and lifestyle advice, and help you make informed decisions.
